# All bass multi-effects — comparison

[Guitar](ALL-GUITAR.md) · [Bass](ALL-BASS.md) · [Vocal](ALL-VOCAL.md) · [Category](MULTI-EFFECTS.md) · [Repository](README.md)

162 recorded bass-focused or explicitly documented bass-capable multi-effects: 38 bass-focused and 124 shared models. This compares actual model records, not only bass-branded units. Capability evidence is listed below; it does not establish equal low-end retention or every effect working equally well on bass.

These are **comparisons of the recorded catalogue**, not exhaustive market coverage or fresh stock certification. Organized 2026-10-16 from the linked source records; their original technical/price dates, firmware, revision and access limits still apply. Every model remains partial. **? means unverified, not No.** Read the complete linked record for sources and conflicting evidence; this view does not silently resolve those conflicts.

K/F/B = independently adjustable rotary controls / footswitches / separate buttons; toe and power switches are additional unless explicitly stated. Body axes and mass qualifications are retained. Color does not prove touch; USB audio does not prove bus power; IRs, native NAM, converted NAM and proprietary captures differ.

CC69 snapshot changes received during preset loads are buffered until loading completes. **Shuffling controls (3.80 p.29):** Slices and SeqLen set chop count and sequence length; Shuffle/Pitch/Reverse/Repeat/Drift control random behavior. Smooth softens slice joins; Playback and Low/Hi Cut shape playback. Interval1/2 span −1 to +1 octave. Parameters can be controller-assigned. Press during playback reshuffles; double-press stops while retaining audio; hold during playback or stop deletes it. Shuffle0% with equal Slices/SeqLen isolates pitch/reverse processing. EXP1 defaults to Wah/Pitch Wham/Poly Wham control and bypass; EXP2 to Volume/Pan control when added through Signal Flow. FS1–6 toggle parameter endpoints; momentary/latching applies per switch, not per assignment. Swapping endpoints reverses control. Reserved global MIDI CCs cannot control parameters. Clear All removes snapshot and default pedal assignments too. Command Center stores assignments per preset, offers six automatic Instant commands, and sends MIDI commands through DIN OUT and USB together; command availability depends on source. ## Scope and provenance

Instrument views overlap and must not be summed. All 370 active models count once in `research-state.json`; the six explicitly excluded archives never enter these tables. Former/donated eligible devices remain without private receipt/order/payment details. Root brand records take precedence where consolidated; legacy sources remain for full evidence until a checked lossless merge. No GitHub workflow is used.
